title: Paying BRAC's Teachers for What Mothers Remembered
conflicts: Reach: 13 million households (Abed to PBS, 2005) vs 12 million families (Gawande, New Yorker 2013) vs more than 12 million women (Yee, NYT 2014) vs about 11.8 million homes (Irene Khan tribute, 2019). Story gives Abed's figure as his recollection and notes others count 12 million. Recipe: fistful of raw sugar/gur (Gawande, BRAC papers) vs handful of sugar (Yee). Origin of the ten-a-day cap (monitors' findings per Gawande vs second pilot per Yee); story follows Gawande. Later coverage: almost 90% for severe diarrhoea (Gawande) vs 78% for all diarrhoea (Yee); story uses Gawande's with its qualifier.
notes: Story includes BRAC's own unflattering 1988 evaluation (5-10% overall use; safety slipping about six months after training), co-written by Abed. Does not credit BRAC alone with national child-mortality decline. Quote stance: affirms.
